name: tealdeer
description: Fast tldr client: short, example-first help pages for commands

avoid.scoop: scoop's manifest sets TEALDEER_CONFIG_DIR in your user environment to its own app folder, which competes with the one DotForge sets.

xdg.instructions: TEALDEER_CONFIG_DIR is the folder holding config.toml (verified tealdeer 1.9.1, tldr --show-paths). The page cache stays in tealdeer's OS folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\tealdeer\cache): TEALDEER_CACHE_DIR is deprecated and warns on every run, and the config's directories.cache_dir takes no variables.
